subject: Comp review: SDE II — Samir Patel (pay mix & vesting)
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Comp review: SDE II — Samir Patel (pay mix & vesting)

Team —

Following the onsite loop, hiring manager (Laura) and I are aligned on a standard SDE II offer for Samir Patel. Before I send to Hannah/TalentLane and the candidate, I want final sign-offs on base/bonus/equity and a quick headcount confirmation. Summary below (recommended):

- Role: SDE II (IC) — Reporting to Laura Bennett
- Base: $155,000/year (mid-band)
- Target bonus: 12% annual (individual performance)
- RSU: 18,000 RSUs (4-year vesting: 25/25/25/25) — cliff at first year
- Sign-on: $20,000 (one-time) to cover counteroffer risk
- Start window: target June 3, flexible by 2–3 weeks
- Budget code: ENG-PLATFORM-Q2-2028 (pending Karthik)

Attachments: 20280315_SamirPatel_offer_sheet.pdf (offer summary), comp-band-matrix-q1-2028.xlsx (band reference).

Questions / asks:
1) Marissa — OK on base/bonus mix and RSU quantity? If you think we should shift RSUs up or down given internal parity, call it out.
2) Karthik — confirm budget code and whether sign-on is approved under the current hiring plan, or if we should route to finance for an exception.
3) Markus — any objection on vesting cadence? Last few SDE II offers moved to 30/30/20/20 in some teams; manager preference please.

If I don’t hear objections by EOD today I’ll route to Hannah and prepare the packet for DocuSign.

Thanks —
Michael
VP, Product Engineering
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: 20280315_SamirPatel_offer_sheet.pdf]
[Attachment: comp-band-matrix-q1-2028.xlsx]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Comp review: SDE II — Samir Patel (pay mix & vesting)

Michael —

Thanks for the clear summary. My read: base and bonus are on band and clean. A couple of quick notes:

- RSU quantity (18k) is fine but recommend shifting vesting to 30/30/20/20 — that helps retention in year 1–2 for this profile.
- Sign-on $20k is reasonable given the candidate’s current counteroffer; if we need to trim for budget, prefer reducing sign-on rather than RSUs.
- Confirm that the comp band used is the same peer bucket we used for Priya last quarter (it looks that way in the matrix).

Approve base and bonus as-is. Approve RSUs contingent on manager OK for 30/30/20/20 cadence.

Marissa
Head of Talent Compensation
Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 12:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Comp review: SDE II — Samir Patel (pay mix & vesting)

Michael / team —

Quick finance check: ENG-PLATFORM-Q2-2028 is the right pool and has capacity for the base + sign-on as proposed, but two caveats:

1) Sign-on over $15k requires an approval routing through Finance Approvals (we can fast-track but need a note in the expense system). If you want to avoid that extra step, reduce sign-on to $15k.
2) If we move RSUs up, we should confirm headcount grade equivalence; increasing RSUs without changing band can complicate year-end calibration.

If everyone prefers speed and keeping the candidate warm, my recommendation is: keep base $155k, bonus 12%, sign-on $15k (fast-track), and adopt the 30/30/20/20 vesting Marissa suggested. Finance will pre-approve the packet once you confirm.

Karthik
Director, Finance (Talent Partnerships)
Redwood Inference

Michael / Laura —

Laura — thanks for interviewing Samir; given the technical profile I support moving to the 30/30/20/20 vesting Marissa recommended. Minor ask: bump RSUs to 19,000 (roughly a 5–6% uplift) to stay aligned with others on the platform team who are at the high-end of the band. If budget is tight, we can hold RSUs at 18k and increase annual merit; I don’t want sign-on to be the retention lever.

Also cc’ing Laura — confirm you’re comfortable with the revised vesting and RSU number. If Laura signs off, I’m good to proceed.

Cheers,
Markus
VP, Engineering Ops
Redwood Inference

Subject: Final: SDE II offer to Samir Patel — confirmed package and next steps

Hannah / Samir —

Thanks all for quick turn-around. Final agreed package below (approved by compensation & finance):

- Base: $155,000
- Target bonus: 12%
- RSUs: 19,000 (4-year vesting: 30% / 30% / 20% / 20%)
- Sign-on: $15,000 (one-time) — adjusted to avoid Finance approval gate for > $15k
- Start: target June 3 (flexible)

Hannah — please prepare the formal offer packet with these numbers. Samir, we’ll send the DocuSign this afternoon; once signed we’ll run onboarding and confirm start date.

Laura has confirmed the IC grade and is comfortable with the equity uplift. Marissa — thank you for the vesting guidance. Karthik — thanks for the sign-on guidance; note the sign-on is adjusted to $15k per finance. Markus — noted the RSU uplift to 19k.

Attachments: final packet (attached to DocuSign). Link: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/0A1B2C3D4E

Best —
